addone.intent: Architecture as the working interface between a human and coding agents.

addone.human.intent: You, through the HUD and the chat.

addone.host.intent: Everything that lives on the agent host side.

addone.host.hosts.intent: Claude Code and Codex, the two first-class hosts.

addone.core.state.intent: Read, validate, select, and apply. The only module that touches .addone/.

addone.core.init.intent: Install ADDONE into a repo: walk the slots, write .addone/, place the skill and hooks.
